name: automem
description: Persistent memory across conversations. Remember preferences, decisions, and project context with AutoMem.

AUTOMEM_API_URL.title: AutoMem API URL
AUTOMEM_API_URL.description: Base URL of your AutoMem REST API (for example https://your-app.railway.app), not the remote MCP /mcp URL. It must be reachable from the computer that runs the plugin; on Grok Bot that is the cloud Bot computer, so localhost will not work.

AUTOMEM_API_KEY.title: AutoMem API key
AUTOMEM_API_KEY.description: API key for your AutoMem service. Leave empty only if your service does not require authentication.
